name: Luna
source:
The sole heir to the Caecius Corporation, and the inventor of the time machine on the undersea railway.
She is beautiful and is versed in both literature and military affairs, but there seems to be a hidden side under her perfect appearance.
There is a rumor going around that she is conducting human experiments.
